title: What If an 8-Day Trip to Space Lasted 9 Months? In 2024 One Did

scenes.text: What if your eight-day trip to space lasted nine months? In 2024, two astronauts found out.
They launched on June fifth in a new Boeing capsule. On the way, it sprang helium leaks and had thruster trouble.
NASA wouldn't risk the ride home. The capsule flew back empty, and its crew joined the space station's.
Days became 286. They circled Earth 4,576 times and traveled 121 million miles.
Up there, astronauts exercise two hours every day, just to slow the loss of bone and muscle.
In March 2025 a SpaceX capsule splashed down off Florida. They were carried out on stretchers for medical checks, smiling.

description:
What if an eight-day trip to space lasted nine months? NASA astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams launched on Boeing's Starliner test flight on 5 June 2024 for a stay of about eight days. Helium leaks and thruster problems on the way up led NASA to send the capsule home empty and keep the pair on the International Space Station.
They came back on a SpaceX Crew Dragon on 18 March 2025 after 286 days, 4,576 orbits and about 121 million miles.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: The longest single flight by a NASA astronaut is 371 days. How long could you last up there? Drop your own what-if below.
